name: smwgraphics-bean
title: Bean
description:
Replaces the little ball tile in GFX00 (tile 3D) with a bean! Turning pea bouncers (sprite 6B and 6C) into bean bouncers!

That tile is also used by the broken block particles, but there's a patch included which remaps the tiles sprite 6B and 6C use to a different one (the default in the patch is 38, the normally unobtainable 5-up's tile).
